## Summary
- Add `podcast overlays` to insert timestamped PNG stills into FCPXML timelines
- Support `.fcpxml`, `.fcpxmld`, and `.fcpxmld/Info.fcpxml` inputs with optional duration/lane/fade-in settings
- Reuse project-sequence frame-rate detection and keep the autoedit frame-rate/swap-channel fixes
- Document the overlay workflow and add coverage for timestamp parsing, bundle inputs, lane assignment, fade-ins, and project timeline anchoring

## Tests
- `python -m compileall -q src`
- `python -m pytest -q`
title: Add FCPXML overlay insertion command
